Fixed-clock part: the task has no graded calendar/date rules. instruction.md and hireops_rules.md contain no due dates, ages, overdue, expiry or 'today' rules; the only graded time quantities are elapsed-time latency windows ('within 15 seconds', rules.md:117; functional judge.toml lines 290/299/335/344/353; polish line 32), which are inherently real elapsed time, not run-date dependent. Seed timestamps (created_at, 2026-07-01..; 130 dated values) are historical and no criterion grades a timestamp or relative age; the golden orders by id/position (index.js:158,166,189,199), using wall clock only to stamp new rows (index.js:59). So no outcome flips with run date. Network public: task.toml:22 and :37-38 network_mode="public" - per row text and SKILL.md Delivery profile, not a defect. Workbook conflict recorded: 'Internal Quality Checks'!D48 still says 'temperature 0, versioned prompt'; the authoritative public 'Quality Checks'!D48 and quality-checks.md #47 Note explicitly say temperature/prompt-version markers are not required and SKILL.md forbids temperature in judge.toml, so their absence is correct. Adversarial probes: (a) broken app passing because of clock - no date-relative criterion exists, so a frozen or skewed app clock cannot earn credit; (b) conforming app failing because of clock - an app ordering messages by its own created_at would only misorder if the verifier host clock predated the 2026-07 seed timestamps, which is not realistic on a 2026-10+ run; recorded as latent only. Notes (not defects, template-controlled, outside this row's change scope): base images node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned; apt packages unpinned (Deterministic Checks C11 treats unpinned apt as NOTE); codex CLI is installed but unused because REWARDKIT_JUDGE=claude-code.
